function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and international horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread and atmospheric tension. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A deeply unsettling family drama that turns into a nightmare. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | Horror meets sharp social commentary. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that subverts expectations. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Tension built around silence and sound. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror rooted in grief and motherhood. |
| 8 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | Slow‑burn, period‑authentic dread. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | Visceral, dance‑driven terror with a haunting score. |
|10 | **Train to Busan** | 2016 | Yeon‑hee Kim | Korean zombie action with emotional depth. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror legend. |
|12 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller. |
|13 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Found‑footage realism that keeps you on edge. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | Atmospheric suspense with a twist ending. |
|15 | **The Descent** | 2005 | Neil Marshall | Cave horror that’s claustrophobic and visceral. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological dread, supernatural scares, or something that blends horror with other genres. Enjoy the chills!
